npcs.name: Kid
lines: Have you seen the windmill on PROF. OAK's lab?
It spins all day long. Grandpa says it powers the whole lab!

lines: MOM is out shopping. You can come back in later.

use.label: Door
lines: Nobody answers. BLUE is probably at the lab already.

use.label: Door
lines: Something smells good... they must be baking bread.

use.label: Door
lines: A sign on the door says: "Gone to feed the PIDGEY. Back soon!"

use.label: Door
lines: Fishing nets hang drying by the door.

use.label: Door
lines: Muddy boots by the door. Ben must be out in the fields.

use.label: Door
lines: OLD TOM's house on the hill.
He says on a clear day you can see CINNABAR from his porch.

use.label: Door
lines: The garden is full of flowers. LILY loves BUTTERFREE.

use.label: Door
lines: The door is locked. PROF. OAK must be out!

use.label: Look
lines: The water is cool and clear. Someone left a coin at the bottom.

use.label: Read
lines: Wild POKéMON hide in tall grass.
Heal up before a long route, and talk to everyone you meet!

use.label: Read
lines: The salty breeze smells like adventure.

use.label: Look
lines: The sea stretches south toward CINNABAR ISLAND.
You'd need a POKéMON that can SURF to go any further.

lines: A little fishing boat, the SEAGULL.
Nets piled in the stern. It smells of salt and fish.

use.label: Look
lines: Oars, nets and a fresh coat of paint drying on a dinghy.

use.label: Read
lines: Jump down a ledge for a shortcut back to PALLET TOWN.
Ledges only go one way: you can't climb back up!

use.label: Look
lines: The gate to VIRIDIAN CITY is shut.
A note: ROAD WORKS AHEAD. Come back another day!

use.label: Read
lines: The road beyond the gate is closed for repairs. Sorry for the trouble!

use.label: Look
lines: The old cottage beside PALLET HOUSE.
Grandma lived here when the restaurant was hers. Her roses still bloom by the door.

use.label: Look
lines: A rake, a spade and a broom lean against it. A cushion in the corner smells of... mime?

use.label: Look
lines: "Home cooking since Grandma's day. Rooms upstairs." The door is shut for now.
